sources.snippet: Hi, I'm Alekhyo Biswas (@alexon-v8) 👋 Systems & Language Developer · Compiler Engineer · Algorithm Designer I design and build programming languages, bytecode virtual machines, cryptographic primitives, and custom graphical/audio synthesis engines—bridging low-level C (C17) systems programming with interactive runtime environments.
